articles.title: 'Scared to death': Over 40,000 people evacuated as Nevada's Hawk fire spreads
articles.description: An additional 45,000 people have been placed under evacuation warnings in the northwestern US state of Nevada. This comes as the fast moving Hawk fire threatens the city of Reno. According to officials the fire was "human caused", but they have not detailed if it was set intentionally. Eight hundred firefighters have been mobilized to bring the blazes under control. Unpredictable winds have complicated the effort, and so far there's been zero percent containment.

articles.title: France and Saudi Arabia hold talks ranging from Middle East to esports

Talks are expected to include the war in Iran and the Strait of Hormuz, as well as new energy routes to bypass the Strait. The two made an appearance at the closing ceremony of the Esports World Cup, held for the first time outside of Saudi Arabia but largely funded by Riyadh.

articles.title: Strategic talks in Paris show France and Saudi Arabia 'need each other too much'

articles.title: Despite ceasefire, Israeli strikes still kill in Gaza and the West Bank
articles.description: Despite a ceasefire that has been in place since October 2025, violence continues in Gaza. On August 23, Israeli strikes left several people dead in the enclave, and a young boy was killed by the Israeli military in the West Bank, according to local authorities. Since the announcement of the truce, more than 1,280 Palestinians have been killed in Gaza, while Israel has reported the launch of drones, balloons and kites towards its territory.

articles.title: Guerre au Moyen-Orient : l'Iran avertit qu'il y aura des «conséquences» pour les pays se joignant aux sanctions économiques américaines
